items.source: Instantiate the supplied MetaProvider type using a no-argument constructor and return the metadata it supplies.
items.translation: 使用无参构造函数实例化提供的MetaProvider类型，并返回其提供的元数据。

items.source: This class provides a single entry point getMeta(Class) that instantiates the given provider type via a no-argument constructor and returns its metadata as an unmodifiable Map.
items.translation: 该类提供了一个单一入口点getMeta(Class)，通过无参数构造函数实例化给定的提供者类型，并将其元数据返回为一个不可修改的Map。

items.source: The returned map is wrapped in Collections.unmodifiableMap(Map) to prevent external modification. If the provider returns null, this method also returns null.
items.translation: 返回的 Map 被包装在Collections.unmodifiableMap(Map)中，以防止外部修改。如果提供者返回null，此方法也返回null。

items.source: Instantiation failures and missing no-arg constructors are reported as IllegalArgumentExceptions. This class is stateless and not intended to be instantiated.
items.translation: 实例化失败和缺少无参构造函数会抛出IllegalArgumentExceptions。该类是无状态的，且不应被实例化。

items.source: metaProviderClass - the MetaProvider implementation class to instantiate; must provide a no-arg constructor
items.translation: metaProviderClass - 要实例化的 MetaProvider 实现类；必须提供无参构造函数

items.source: an unmodifiable metadata map, or null if the provider returns null
items.translation: 一个不可修改的元数据映射，或者如果提供者返回 null，则为 null

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if a no-arg constructor is missing or the instance cannot be created
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果缺少无参构造函数或无法创建实例
瓦季姆·舒尔米亚乌，克雷格·沃尔斯

items.source: Utility methods for working with MetaProvider metadata.
items.translation: 用于处理MetaProvider元数据的实用方法。
